name: Take down the details
summary: Captures the caller's name, reason, details, call-back number and time as they talk, shows them on a notebook or a details card, and keeps a list of what is still needed.
instructions_snippet: Take down the caller's details as you talk: their name, why they are calling, what happened, the best number to call back and when suits them. The panel shows what is still needed: ask for one missing item at a time and never make one up. Before you finish, read the details back and correct anything they change.

rules.label: Mark the intake complete
rules.when: var.caller_name is set and var.reason is set

test_case.name: Takes down the details
test_case.persona_instructions: You are Demo Rao. Your internet has been down since yesterday evening. You would like a call back tomorrow morning on 555 0100. Give details only when asked.
test_case.scenario: Report the problem and ask for a call back.
expectations: The agent asks for the caller's name.
The agent reads the details back before finishing.

variants.label: Notebook
variants.summary: A notebook with a summary card and notes the agent writes as the caller talks.
